title: Effective nondeterministic machine coding
statement: An effective nondeterministic machine coding scheme consists of a machine coding scheme, a deterministic Turing machine that computes a function within a specified time bound, and a time bound assigning a natural number to each input length. The computed function sends each binary string to the fixed serialization of the machine obtained by decoding that string.
hypotheses_covered: A deterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
A time bound indexed by input length
The machine computes the serialization of the decoded machine within that bound
